verdict.rationale: Catalog and inventory management is a fair question for a point-of-sale payments product, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows Adyen In-Person Payments providing an item catalog or inventory counts; the docs describe terminals, payments, refunds and tipping that plug into the merchant's existing POS system. The marketing line "Real-time data sync across all channels" is a general data claim, not a documented catalog or inventory-sync capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can manage an item catalog with inventory counts that stay in sync across registers and channels
